sections.installation:
1. Install ‘WordAI’ Auto Content Writer by uploading the plugin to the ‘/wp-content/plugins/’ directory inside.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. First put your open AI API key through ‘API Settings’ page of the plugin.
  4. Then you are ready to generate auto content / HD images for your WordPress!
sections.faq:
What is “WordAI” plugin?

“WordAI” is an advanced AI-powered Auto Content Writer plugin that uses OpenAI technology to generate high-quality, human-like content and images in seconds. It helps you create SEO-optimized content and stunning visuals automatically, saving you time while boosting your website’s performance.

Do generated Titles and Content look natural, like human writing?

Yes! All Titles and Content created by WordAI are highly natural, relevant, and human-like, making them almost indistinguishable from professional human writing.

How does the “WordAI” plugin generate content and images?

WordAI uses the latest Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Natural Language Processing (NLP) models from OpenAI to produce unique, SEO-friendly content and professional-quality images based on your input.

Is the generated content and images unique?

Absolutely. Every piece of content and every image generated is unique, human-friendly, and SEO-optimized, ensuring your website stands out with fresh material every time.

Can I generate content in languages other than English?

Yes! WordAI supports all major languages worldwide. Simply select your preferred language in the Content Settings menu, and the plugin will generate content in that language.

Does WordAI support the latest AI models?

Yes. WordAI supports the latest GPT-5 all models including GPT-4o model, the cost-efficient GPT-4o mini, and is also fully compatible with all Open AI models, ensuring future-proof AI performance.

Can I control how many paragraphs are generated?

Yes. In the Content Settings menu, you can easily choose the number of paragraphs you want by adjusting the Content Paragraph Number option.

Can I set image size and limit the number of images?

Yes. WordAI gives you full control in the Image Settings menu, where you can choose available image sizes and set the number of images to generate.

Why are my generated results sometimes cut off or incomplete?

This usually happens due to incorrect API parameter settings. To fix this, go to WordAI → API Settings and click Reset Settings to restore defaults. After that, you can re-adjust models or parameters as needed.

Why don’t I see any output or generated content?

This may occur if your server has restrictions with the streaming feature. To resolve it, go to WordAI → API Settings, uncheck the Streaming option, then click Save API Settings and try again.

Why am I not seeing AI-generated content or images properly?

If parameters are changed incorrectly, it may cause issues. To resolve this, you can simply click the “Reset Settings” button to restore the default configurations in the API Settings / Content Settings / Image Settings pages. You may also try enabling or disabling the Streaming option in the API settings page to check functionality.

Please ensure the following:

The API key in your application is correct and active. You can verify or regenerate it from the OpenAI platform.

Your OpenAI account is in good standing and has sufficient credits or a valid subscription.

Your network setup (such as proxy or firewall) is not interfering with the streaming connection. Note that OpenAI may restrict API access from certain geographical regions, which can affect streaming performance.

Why do I get an error message like “Could not resolve host: api.openai.com”?

This error usually occurs due to internet firewall or server restrictions that prevent the plugin from connecting to the OpenAI API. To resolve this, you can contact your hosting provider or adjust/remove any firewall or network restrictions that may be blocking communication with the OpenAI server.

sections.description:
AI-powered, human-like content creation with SEO optimization and high-definition image generation. Effortlessly automate your blog posts, pages, and product content to save time, boost engagement, and grow your online presence. This plugin streamlines your workflow by writing high-quality Posts, Pages, and Product Descriptions with zero hassle. Perfect for marketers, bloggers, and eCommerce owners looking to scale content without sacrificing quality.

Videos

How to generate natural humanlike SEO friendly content
How to use suggest title feature to generate more SEO friendly title names
How to generate Dall-E 3 HD images

WordAI Auto Content Writer – Supercharge your website with the power of Artificial Intelligence! Instantly create unique, SEO-optimized content and pair it with stunning HD images generated by DALL·E 2, DALL·E 3 and GPT IMAGE 1 models. From blog posts to product descriptions, WordAI helps you publish professional, engaging, and conversion-driven content in just a few clicks – saving you time and boosting your online presence. Whether you need compelling text or professional visuals, WordAI delivers it all in one seamless platform.

To start using WordAI, you’ll need to register with OpenAI. Please review Terms of use
and Privacy Policy.

WordAI – AI-Driven SEO Content and HD Images Creator

  • Auto Title Generator – Instantly create eye-catching, SEO-friendly titles to boost clicks and improve rankings.

  • Auto Content Generator – Generate unique, high-quality, SEO-optimized content that saves hours of manual writing.

  • Auto Tags Generator – Automatically add relevant tags to maximize visibility and improve search engine indexing.

  • Auto Excerpt Generator – Craft compelling excerpts that capture attention and drive higher engagement.

  • HD Image Generator – Create professional, high-resolution images with support for all OpenAI image models to make your content stand out.

  • Smart Title Suggestions – Get AI-powered title recommendations and update them instantly with one click to keep your content fresh and appealing.

  • Multi-Language Support – Write content in any major language to expand your reach and engage global audiences.

  • Custom Writing Styles – Choose from multiple content styles to perfectly match your brand’s identity.

  • Flexible Writing Tones – Adapt your message with different tones (professional, casual, persuasive, etc.) to connect with your audience.

  • Custom Image Sizes – Generate images in different OpenAI-supported sizes for blogs, websites, and social media.

  • WooCommerce Title & Content Generation – Automatically generate optimized product titles, descriptions, and short descriptions to increase sales.

  • WooCommerce Product Images – Instantly create high-quality product images that attract customers and improve conversions.

  • Powered by GPT-4o – Access the latest AI technology for fast, reliable, and highly accurate content creation.

  • Supports GPT-4o Mini – Use the most cost-efficient AI model to save on costs while maintaining quality output.

  • Latest GPT-5 models Support – Fully compatible with GPT-5 models, ensuring your business stays ahead with the newest AI advancements.
